notes: Two-stage run. Stage 1 upn_a (slurm 47394816.41, 89.8 min, 14786 steps, configs/hf_upernet.yaml): from openmmlab/upernet-convnext-tiny, 512 crops x16/step (70% peak-centred), AdamW 2e-4 (backbone x0.5), 10*focal(alpha .75)+dice; its val-picked best.pt (step 3000) + flip-TTA gave test peak F1 0.8886 (landed first, 2f54d3c; logs/evals under .../h4/upn_a). Stage 2 upn_ft (this result; slurm 47394816.86, 57.7 min, 8492 steps, configs/hf_upernet_ft.yaml): fine-tune of upn_a best.pt with saturated pixels (>=60000) zeroed in the input adapter, focal alpha .5, lr 5e-5, pos_frac .5. Selection on VAL only (scripts/val_grid.py, the same 400 evenly spaced val images used for upn_a): upn_ft best.pt (step 1000) + flip-TTA + thr 0.9999 = val F1 0.8981 vs upn_a 0.8925; no-TTA 0.8891; upn_ft last.pt 0.8891 (TTA). Both stages drift to over-confidence with longer training (recall ~.98-.99, precision falls) under focal+dice with peak-centred crops, so early checkpoints + very high thresholds win. Dead ends: upn_ft v1 initialised from upn_a last.pt (val .853 at step 1000, killed); stem stride 2 (smoke only, 3.7x slower). train_images = 15989 (both stages).
